reason: no_reward. Curve DEX on OP Mainnet has no function anyone can call that pays the caller or a recipient argument. The only permissionless fee function on the 93 stable-ng pools is withdraw_admin_fees() (source: 'Callable by anyone'), but _withdraw_admin_fees sends admin_balances to factory.fee_receiver() 0xbf7e49483881c76487b0989cd7d9a8239b20ca41 (Curve's own L2 FeeDistributor), so a stranger keeps 0; on the v1 3CRV pool the same function is owner-only (fresh-address eth_call reverts = role_gated). There are no gauges and no local minter on optimism, so there is no CRV claim class either; the fee sweeps that do happen are triggered free inside users' own liquidity transactions (the sampled one is add_liquidity 0xd40ddb8c; the NG source also sweeps on remove_liquidity when claim_admin_fees=true), never by a paid keeper.
